persona.name: Alex
persona.tone: warm, sharp, and friendly, like a thoughtful recruiter rather than a script
persona.systemPrompt: You are {bot}, a warm, sharp recruiter running a short voice screen for {company}. Speak in short spoken sentences. Ask exactly one question. Do not use lists, markdown, or stage directions. Do not invent the candidate's experience. Stay on this step: {phase}. Time left: {seconds} seconds. If time is almost gone, wrap up kindly and do not open a new topic. You may rephrase the intended line so it sounds natural, but keep the same intent. The intended line is: "{scripted}". Reply with only the words you will speak.

interview.openingGreeting: Hi {name}, thanks for making the time. I'm {bot}, and I'll walk you through a short screen for the {role} role at {company}. It should take about {minutes} minutes. {warmup}
interview.closingMessage: Thank you, {name}. That's everything I need for this screen. The hiring team will read it and be in touch. Have a good rest of your day.
interview.partialClosingMessage: Thank you, {name}. We'll stop here so we don't run over. What you shared is saved, and the team will see that the screen ended early.
interview.hardStopMessage: We've reached the end of the time, so I'll stop here. Thank you, {name}.
interview.timeWarningMessage: About a minute left. We'll wrap up shortly.
warmupQuestions: Tell me a little about what you're doing these days.
What's a piece of work from the last year or two that you're proud of?
interview.typingHint: Speak your answer, or type it if the microphone is being difficult.

candidateQuestions.prompt: We have a little time left. Is there anything you want to ask about the role?
candidateQuestions.reply: Thank you for asking. The hiring team can go into that properly in the next conversation. I don't want to guess on their behalf.

prompts.light: Could you add one concrete example — what you did, and what changed?
prompts.medium: Walk me through that a little more slowly. What was the situation, what did you do, and how did it end?
prompts.deep: Let's stay with that. What was hard, what did you try, and what would you do differently?

flow.logisticsPrompt: A few practical things, so nobody wastes your time later. How many years have you been doing this kind of work, what's your current pay, what are you hoping for, what's your notice period, and does {location} work for you — including whether you'd relocate?

prompts: How do you decide when a React component is doing too much?
Where do you keep TypeScript strict, and where have you had to loosen it?
What sits on the request path in Node, and how do you notice when it gets slow?
Which parts of the system did you keep in Python, and what did you test most carefully?
Which AWS pieces have you run in production, and what broke?
What did you last change in a deployment, and how did you know it was safe?
What would you want to learn in the first 90 days of this role?

questionTemplates.matchedSkill: I saw {skill} in your background. Tell me about a time you used it when the outcome actually mattered.
questionTemplates.secondSkill: How about {skill} — where did you last rely on it, and what did you learn the hard way?
questionTemplates.missingSkill: This role depends on {skill}. Where have you come closest, even if it wasn't your job title?
questionTemplates.impact: You mentioned "{snippet}". What was your part in that, specifically?
questionTemplates.genericImpact: Tell me about something you shipped that was harder than it looked from the outside.
questionTemplates.probe: I want to go one step deeper. {prompt}

retryPrompts: I didn't quite catch that. Take your time and try once more.
Still with you. Say that again when you're ready, or type it.
silence.noSpeechPrompt: I'm not hearing anything yet. You can speak again, or type your answer below.

mandatoryQuestions.prompt: [Replace this question] Why are you looking to move right now?
[Replace this question] Walk me through the project you spent the most time on last year.
[Replace this question] Which required skill on this role have you used most, and how deep does that go?
[Replace this question] Is there anything about location, timing, or pay we should know before the next step?

reasonTemplates.weakSkills: They showed only {matched} of {total} required skills.
reasonTemplates.experienceLow: Experience looks below the {min} year minimum.
reasonTemplates.experienceUnknown: They did not give a clear number of years.
reasonTemplates.payOk: Expected pay sits inside the budget.
reasonTemplates.payHigh: Expected pay is above the budget.
reasonTemplates.payUnknown: They did not state expected pay.
reasonTemplates.noticeOk: Notice period fits the limit you set.
reasonTemplates.noticeLong: Notice period is longer than the limit you set.
reasonTemplates.noticeUnknown: They did not state a notice period.
reasonTemplates.mandatoryMissed: {count} of your questions were not answered.
reasonTemplates.optionalSkipped: Some extra questions were skipped to stay inside the time limit.

redFlagTemplates.payHigh: Expected pay is above the budget.
redFlagTemplates.noticeLong: Notice period is longer than {max} days.

scoring.reviewFlagTemplate: The answer to "{question}" may have been misheard. Confidence was {confidence}. This did not change the score.

maybe.label: Maybe
maybe.summary: Some fit, with gaps to check.

reject.label: Reject
reject.summary: Does not meet the bar you set.

partial.label: Partial
partial.summary: The screen ended before it was finished.

pdf.footer: Confidential. For the hiring team. Produced in the browser and not sent to a server.
pdf.truncationNote: The transcript was shortened at the configured limit.

notifications.emailBody: {name} finished a screen for {role}. Score {score} out of 100. Recommendation: {recommendation}. The report and video are in the downloaded bundle.

privacy.consentBody: This is a short voice screen. It lasts at most five minutes and runs entirely in your browser. We ask to use your camera and microphone so the hiring team can watch the conversation later. The bot's words are written on the video and kept in a transcript. If your speakers are on, the microphone may also pick up the bot's voice. Nothing is uploaded unless you choose to send the result file, email it, or use a storage option your recruiter has turned on with your Google account. You can type any answer if speech recognition struggles. Accents and quiet rooms are not used to lower your score. You can close this page now and nothing will be saved.
privacy.consentCheckbox: I agree to this screen being recorded and saved as a report for the hiring team.
privacy.consentDeclineText: If you don't agree, close this page. Nothing is saved.

recording.hint: The video records your camera and microphone. The bot's words are written on the video. Browsers cannot tap the built-in voice directly, so the bot's voice is mixed in when your speakers are picked up by the microphone. Headphones keep the recording to your voice. The transcript always has every bot line.

links.shareMessage: Interview link for {name} — {role}. About {minutes} minutes, in the browser.

roleForm.skillsHelp: Comma-separated. CVs and screens are scored against these.
roleForm.budgetHelp: Use the same units you expect people to say. For example 20 and 40 if you mean 20 to 40 LPA.

copy.roleEmptyTitle: What role are you hiring for?
copy.roleEmptyBody: Add the role once. Then you can add CVs and make an interview link for each person.
copy.emptyCandidates: No candidates yet. Add CVs to score them and make interview links.
copy.settingsIntro: These control the interview, the score, and the report. They stay on this browser.
copy.confirmDelete: Delete {name} and their recording? This cannot be undone.
copy.placeholderBanner: Your interview questions are still placeholders. Change them in Settings before you invite people.
copy.bundleHelp: If you are on a different computer from the recruiter, send them this file. It contains the report, the transcript, and the video.
copy.reportReady: The report is ready on this browser as well.
copy.rawJsonHelp: For everything at once. If a value is invalid, that one value is put back to a safe default and the rest is kept.
copy.earlierRulesHelp: Reports keep the score rules they were made with, so an old report does not change when you edit settings.
copy.retentionNote: Screens older than {days} days are deleted from this browser.
copy.qrTooLong: This link is too long for a QR code. Use Copy link.
copy.modelLoading: On-device phrasing is loading. The interview will not wait for it.
copy.cameraFailed: The camera or microphone could not start.
copy.madeLocally: Runs in the browser. No account.
copy.lowConfidenceNote: Some lines were hard to hear. They are marked for a person to check. They did not lower the communication score.
copy.mandatoryHelp: Asked after the two opening questions, before anything else. All of them are asked. Replace the placeholders before you invite real people.
copy.weightTotal: Weights are relative. They do not need to add up to 100.
copy.exampleConfirm: This replaces the people currently on this browser.
copy.nothingToPurge: Nothing was old enough to delete.
copy.driveHelp: Optional. A free Google OAuth client id lets someone upload the result file to their own Drive. Leave blank to skip.
copy.mailtoHelp: Optional. Opens an email draft. It does not send by itself, and it cannot attach the video.
copy.emailjsHelp: Optional EmailJS free tier. Sends a short note, not the video. Leave off if you don't use it.
